title: THARWATISM - A Leadership Podcast
author: THARWATISM
description: Tharwatism — built around a personal leadership philosophy. Most leadership advice was written for executives who've never managed a district, closed a store, or had a difficult conversation in a break room. Tharwatism is different. This is real talk for real managers — the first-line leaders holding everything together while no one's watching. Raw insights, no corporate fluff, straight from the field.
